# Custom-role change review

Free includes 1 custom role; Premium includes up to 5. Presets remain unchanged. Counts use normalized distinct titles across shortcuts and active contacts. Existing titles and approved queued snapshots remain usable. No dependencies, database columns, indexes, or migrations were added.

## Server enforcement

All new-title checks call `canUseRole` through the shared `roleLimitErrors` helper:

- `src/lib/actions.ts` — `savePreferences`: final shortcut set plus active contacts, preserving existing titles and atomic replacements.
- `src/lib/actions.ts` — `saveContact`: create, edit, email-based upsert, and restore; excludes the replaced active contact's former contribution.
- `src/lib/actions.ts` — `importContacts`: text and array input; CSV authorization still precedes parsing; distinct titles accumulate across valid rows; role failures return `fieldErrors["rows.<index>.jobRole"]` and write nothing.
- `src/lib/campaigns.ts` — `createCampaign`, reached by authenticated `submitCampaign`: validates each effective recipient role and accumulates new titles across the submitted batch without persisting overrides.

`src/lib/campaign-policy.ts` no longer cancels campaigns because of custom-role snapshots. Existing downgrade, dispatch, delivery, quota, template, and repeat-send checks remain. Snapshot eligibility survives downgrade and contact removal. Historical custom-role cancellation notices describe the former policy.

Counts and writes run under the existing owner-row transaction lock. The effective plan comes from the existing entitlement resolver; custom-role caps apply even with plan gating disabled.

## Privacy Policy — review these changes

Displayed date: **Effective October 20, 2026** → **Effective October 21, 2026**.

Only plan-feature sentences and plan naming changed. No data-processing, retention, consent, liability, or other legal clauses were added or rewritten. Full affected paragraphs are reproduced below to preserve context.

**Before**

> We use Gmail sending permission to send each approved message individually from your account. Mailloop requests Gmail sending permission only and never reads your inbox, threads, or Sent folder. Paid users use Mark replied manually; this stops reminders for that contact. Mailloop does not detect replies. Gmail acceptance status reports that Gmail accepted an email, not guaranteed recipient delivery. Uncertain sends stay Needs review and are never automatically resent. Paid follow-up reminders use your choice of 3, 7, or 14 elapsed days since sending unless a reply is marked. You decide whom to follow up with and approve each message. Reminders never send automatically.

**After**

> We use Gmail sending permission to send each approved message individually from your account. Mailloop requests Gmail sending permission only and never reads your inbox, threads, or Sent folder. Premium users use Mark replied manually; this stops reminders for that contact. Mailloop does not detect replies. Gmail acceptance status reports that Gmail accepted an email, not guaranteed recipient delivery. Uncertain sends stay Needs review and are never automatically resent. Premium follow-up reminders use your choice of 3, 7, or 14 elapsed days since sending unless a reply is marked. You decide whom to follow up with and approve each message. Reminders never send automatically.

**Before**

> Paid costs ₹299/month for India; US$5.99/month globally, including applicable tax. Billing country determines eligibility; checkout shows the final quote. Free includes 15 emails/month and 3/UTC day; Paid includes 300/month and 20/UTC day. Compare all features and limits on Pricing. Your workspace shows the allowances enforced during rollout.

**After**

> Premium costs ₹299/month for India; US$5.99/month globally, including applicable tax. Billing country determines eligibility; checkout shows the final quote. Free includes 15 emails/month and 3/UTC day; Premium includes 300/month and 20/UTC day. Free includes 1 custom role; Premium includes up to 5. Compare all features and limits on Pricing. Your workspace shows the allowances enforced during rollout.

**Before**

> Daily allowances reset at midnight UTC. Free monthly allowances reset on the first day of each UTC calendar month; Paid monthly allowances follow the verified subscription billing period. Queued emails reserve capacity; manually sent follow-up emails consume allowances. Unused emails do not roll over.

**After**

> Daily allowances reset at midnight UTC. Free monthly allowances reset on the first day of each UTC calendar month; Premium monthly allowances follow the verified subscription billing period. Queued emails reserve capacity; manually sent follow-up emails consume allowances. Unused emails do not roll over.

**Before**

> Paid renews monthly. Request period-end cancellation in Usage; cancellation remains pending until verified, and verified access continues through the current period. Failed renewals retain access only until a verified grace deadline shown in Usage. No refunds, except where required by applicable law.

**After**

> Premium renews monthly. Request period-end cancellation in Usage; cancellation remains pending until verified, and verified access continues through the current period. Failed renewals retain access only until a verified grace deadline shown in Usage. No refunds, except where required by applicable law.

**Before**

> Abuse or security issues may lead to suspension. Suspension does not cancel billing; billing management, export, deletion, and support remain accessible. You are responsible for honoring recipients’ requests not to be contacted. Paid support emails at [REDACTED_EMAIL] are prioritized without a response-time or 24/7 promise.

**After**

> Abuse or security issues may lead to suspension. Suspension does not cancel billing; billing management, export, deletion, and support remain accessible. You are responsible for honoring recipients’ requests not to be contacted. Premium support emails at [REDACTED_EMAIL] are prioritized without a response-time or 24/7 promise.

## Terms of Service — review these changes

Displayed date: **Effective October 20, 2026** → **Effective October 21, 2026**.

The embedded comparison table has the exact row, heading, and caption changes listed above. Other changes are plan naming in existing feature/payment descriptions and shared allowance text. No new legal clauses were added.

**Before**

> You approve campaigns in Compose. Each recipient receives their own email; batches do not use CC or BCC. Your workspace shows your plan's daily and monthly sending allowances, including queued reservations. Daily allowances reset at midnight UTC. Free monthly allowances reset on the first day of each UTC calendar month; Paid monthly allowances follow the verified subscription billing period. Unused emails do not roll over. Manually sent follow-up emails also consume allowances. Where plan limits are disabled, the legacy limit is 200 emails per rolling 24 hours. Free includes 15 emails/month, 3/day and 3/campaign. Paid includes 300/month, 20/day and 10/campaign. Sends are normally spaced about 5 seconds apart; Gmail limits may extend waits. Google may deny delivery. Uncertain attempts retain their period's capacity and are never automatically retried.

**After**

> You approve campaigns in Compose. Each recipient receives their own email; batches do not use CC or BCC. Your workspace shows your plan's daily and monthly sending allowances, including queued reservations. Daily allowances reset at midnight UTC. Free monthly allowances reset on the first day of each UTC calendar month; Premium monthly allowances follow the verified subscription billing period. Unused emails do not roll over. Manually sent follow-up emails also consume allowances. Where plan limits are disabled, the legacy limit is 200 emails per rolling 24 hours. Free includes 15 emails/month, 3/day and 3/campaign. Premium includes 300/month, 20/day and 10/campaign. Sends are normally spaced about 5 seconds apart; Gmail limits may extend waits. Google may deny delivery. Uncertain attempts retain their period's capacity and are never automatically retried.

**Before**

> Queued emails can be cancelled only before delivery begins. Actively sending and uncertain deliveries cannot be stopped or recalled. A successful Gmail API response does not guarantee arrival, inbox placement, a reply, or a job opportunity. Timings are estimates. Paid users use the Mark replied button manually; marking a reply stops reminders for that contact. Mailloop does not read your inbox or detect replies. SENT means Gmail accepted submission, not confirmed recipient delivery. Uncertain delivery stays Needs review. You can check Gmail Sent yourself; Mailloop offers no confirmation or resend control for uncertain sends. Paid follow-up reminders use 3, 7, or 14 elapsed days since sending unless you mark a reply. You decide whom to follow up with and approve each message. Reminders never automatically send messages.

**After**

> Queued emails can be cancelled only before delivery begins. Actively sending and uncertain deliveries cannot be stopped or recalled. A successful Gmail API response does not guarantee arrival, inbox placement, a reply, or a job opportunity. Timings are estimates. Premium users use the Mark replied button manually; marking a reply stops reminders for that contact. Mailloop does not read your inbox or detect replies. SENT means Gmail accepted submission, not confirmed recipient delivery. Uncertain delivery stays Needs review. You can check Gmail Sent yourself; Mailloop offers no confirmation or resend control for uncertain sends. Premium follow-up reminders use 3, 7, or 14 elapsed days since sending unless you mark a reply. You decide whom to follow up with and approve each message. Reminders never automatically send messages.

**Before**

> Paid costs ₹299/month for India; US$5.99/month globally. Prices include applicable tax. Billing country determines eligibility; Dodo checkout shows the final quote. Dodo Payments is the payment processor and Merchant of Record. Billing is currently test mode only when configured and enabled; real charges are not enabled.

**After**

> Premium costs ₹299/month for India; US$5.99/month globally. Prices include applicable tax. Billing country determines eligibility; Dodo checkout shows the final quote. Dodo Payments is the payment processor and Merchant of Record. Billing is currently test mode only when configured and enabled; real charges are not enabled.

**Before**

> Paid renews monthly. Request cancellation at period end in Usage; the request remains pending until verified. Verified Paid access continues to the end of the current period. A failed renewal retains access only through a verified grace deadline shown in Usage; otherwise Paid access ends. Suspension does not cancel billing.

**After**

> Premium renews monthly. Request cancellation at period end in Usage; the request remains pending until verified. Verified Premium access continues to the end of the current period. A failed renewal retains access only through a verified grace deadline shown in Usage; otherwise Premium access ends. Suspension does not cancel billing.

**Before**

> Paid email support requests at [REDACTED_EMAIL] are prioritized, without a guaranteed response time or 24/7 support promise.

**After**

> Premium email support requests at [REDACTED_EMAIL] are prioritized, without a guaranteed response time or 24/7 support promise.

The paragraph containing the public-plan summary above shows the plan-gating-enabled wording. With gating disabled, its existing “Send up to 10 recipients per campaign, within 200 emails per rolling 24 hours.” summary remains unchanged; the shared allowance-reset text still changes “Paid monthly” to “Premium monthly”.

## Validation

- Unit suite: 364 passed; database suites are opt-in and skipped in this run.
- Disposable PostgreSQL database checks: 68 passed across feature gates, actions, entitlement foundation, and launch suites, including the new role regression scenarios.
- TypeScript: passed.
- Browser: 10 passed across desktop and mobile, covering role counters, lock tooltip keyboard/hover behavior, grandfathering, pricing, and both policy pages. Accessibility checks passed.
- ESLint: passed without warnings.
- `git diff --check`: passed.
